intro:

With its simple yet addictive gameplay, adorable visuals, and challenging obstacles, this game is sure to delight players of all ages. As players progress through the levels, the game introduces new challenges and obstacles, such as salt shakers, graters, and even pesky cookies that will try to distract you from your goal.

One of the standout features of Cat Chef and Broccoli is its visual style and atmosphere.
